projects.title: Smart Parking System (Academic)
projects.description: An IoT-based web application featuring real-time slot monitoring, an interactive analytics dashboard, and automated QR code ticket generation to prevent urban parking congestion.
projects.architecture: Hardware ultrasonic sensors stream occupancy telemetry over HTTP/WebSocket -> Flask REST API validates and updates slot matrix -> Real-time React dashboard renders live map -> Automated dynamic QR token generated for driver entry/exit validation.
highlights: Eliminated urban parking bottlenecks with instant live slot availability tracking
Automated cryptographic QR ticket generation for seamless check-ins
Built responsive real-time analytics dashboard displaying peak parking metrics

projects.title: Procurement Intelligence System
projects.description: An AI-powered system designed to analyze vendor supply options, streamline purchase approval workflows, and optimize high-throughput data handling processes within commercial software pipelines.
projects.architecture: Inbound vendor purchase logs ingested via asynchronous pipelines -> Python data models calculate risk, price variance, and delivery velocity -> Machine learning scoring engine ranks optimal suppliers -> Flask dashboard surfaces recommendations with exportable BI audits.
highlights: Automated supplier quote evaluation reducing procurement cycle times by 40%
Structured multi-vendor data normalization pipelines with SQLite/MySQL
Interactive KPI monitoring for pricing anomalies and SLA reliability

projects.title: AWS Resume Analyzer
projects.description: A cloud-native resume intelligence tool that parses candidate CVs, extracts key engineering skills and insights, and scores competencies against job requirements using AWS services.
projects.architecture: Resume uploads routed to secure storage -> Python parsing engine extracts plain text and tokenizes candidate skill graphs -> AWS text & entity models score keyword relevance against role profiles -> Generates match breakdown report with gap analysis.
highlights: Cloud-native architecture engineered with Python and AWS integrations
Automated PDF and DOCX tokenization with high entity extraction accuracy
Detailed match score output categorizing technical proficiencies vs role requirements
